extracted.name: Mac & cheese
extracted.description: This recipe is for cheese lovers.
instruction_lines: This is a regular white sauce but with cheddar cheese and a few more ingredients, first mix in a pot, the flour, butter, pepper and ground mustard. mix them until the the flour is good, put the milk then mix until thickened put the cheddar cheese and the salt.
Put the boiled macaroni in and mix all together....... Enjoy.
Remark: mozzarella can be added with the cheddar cheese.
